title: Research gap — Nadia's new pill
caption:
8 of the last 10 drugs pulled in the US were riskier for women (GAO, 2001). Trials excluded us until 1993. Ask if your dose was studied in women. Send this to her. Told 'it's rare' before?
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #genderhealthgap #medicalgaslighting #womeninresearch #patientadvocacy

scenes.text: New pill, and you're *dizzy* every morning. Told that's rare?
scenes.suggest: → Ask if the dose was studied in women (GAO 2001)

scenes.text: Three visits, same answer: probably anxiety. The dizziness started the day the pill did.
phrases: It started the day the pill did.

scenes.text: Of the 10 drugs the US pulled from shelves, 8 were riskier for women than men.
For 16 years, FDA guidance kept women of childbearing age out of early trials.
phrases: 1977: keep women out of early trials.
In 1993 Congress made including us the law (NIH Revitalization Act).

scenes.text: Write the date you started it and what your body did. Take those two lines in.
phrases: Two lines in your phone notes.
Date started. What changed, and when.
Then ask: was this dose studied in women?
